desc: Every bowl of Basic 4 Cereal brings you basically everything you need for a delicious morning. Enjoy a mouthwatering medley of coated vanilla clusters, crispy multigrain flakes, sweet and tangy fruit, crispy rice puffs, and crunchy almonds. The perfect balance of hearty flakes plus these four simple components help you start your day off right. Beyond tasty, Basic 4 is a good source of fiber (5g fiber and 2g fat per serving) and vitamin D. Each serving provides 26g of whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily) and is a heart healthy* breakfast food. Serve this multigrain cereal with fruit and almonds with cold milk as part of a quick breakfast. Layer cereal into a yogurt parfait for an enticing crunch. Add some to heart healthy* cereal bars or homemade trail mix for convenient on the go snacks. Whether you choose Basic 4 as part of a breakfast, snack with whole grains, or ingredient in heart healthy* snacks recipes, General Mills breakfast cereals spread goodness from tots to grown-ups. *While many factors affect heart disease, diets low in saturated fat and cholesterol may reduce the risk of this disease. Basic 4 Cereal is low in fat, low in saturated fat and naturally cholesterol free. Contains one cardboard box of crunchy Basic 4 Heart Healthy Cereal, Fruit and Nut Fiber Cereal with Whole Grain, 19.8 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals.
features:
Whole Grain Rich: ~26 g whole grain per 1‑cup serving; meets whole‑grain guidelines .

Heart‑Healthy Profile: Low in total fat (~2 g), saturated fat (~0.5–1 g), and cholesterol‑free .

ber & Nutrient Boost: 5 g fiber, good source of calcium, iron, vitamin D.

grain, fruits & nuts combo: Combines flakes, raisins, cranberries, almonds – a blend of textures & flavors.

Convenient & Kosher‑certified: Ready‑to‑eat cereal suitable for quick breakfast or snack .
ingredients: Whole Grain Wheat, Corn Meal, Sugar, Raisins, Rice Flour, Almond Pieces, Brown Sugar Syrup, Glycerin, Whole Grain Oats, Dried Cranberries, Salt, Corn Syrup, Palm Kernel Oil, Brown Sugar, Barley Malt Extract, Dextrose, Honey, Color (Caramel Color & Annatto Extract), Cinnamon, Soy Lecithin, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor, Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) added as preservative. Enriched with calcium carbonate, sodium ascorbate (vitamin C), iron, zinc, niacinamide, pyridoxine HCl, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid, vitamin B12, vitamin A palmitate, vitamin D3.
